name: UI Annotate
description: Click through any web UI, mark elements, comment them, and collect the notes as a structured ticket or hand them to an agent (long-poll endpoint, CLI, Butler). Works on any web app via a script tag or bookmarklet; pairs with App Runner for apps the board runs.

views.label: UI Annotate
views.description: Collector dashboard: overlay snippet/bookmarklet, the collected annotations, copy-as-ticket, agent long-poll URL.

scripts.name: export
scripts.label: Export as ticket markdown
scripts.description: Read-only: print the open annotations as ticket-ready markdown.

scripts.name: poll
scripts.label: Long-poll for feedback
scripts.description: Block until annotations change (or 25s), print them as JSON. For agent terminals.

scripts.name: selftest
scripts.label: Self-test
scripts.description: Offline self-test: boots the collector, drives the API, long-poll and export.
